title: Senior Marketing Manager
must_have: 6+ years of experience in digital marketing
text:
Senior Marketing Manager
Saffron Digital | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a senior marketing manager to join our digital marketing team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Social Media Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Campaign Management
- Brand Management
- Copywriting
- 6+ years of experience in digital marketing

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Influencer Outreach
- A/B Testing
- HubSpot
- Google Analytics

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive customer acquisition drive with measurable outcomes.
- Drive retention programme with measurable outcomes.
- Drive regional expansion push with measurable outcomes.
